prompt: Round 3 of 6. The researcher side proposes (We want university ownership with an option for the company to licence the foreground IP, preserving academic public

content.text:
The researcher moved from company_owns to uni_owns_option_to_licence and reduced review days from 60 to 30. I need to decide whether to accept or counter-propose.

Key concerns: IP ownership and review days. I'd prefer company ownership, but uni_owns_option_to_licence gives us a path to licence. The bigger issue is review days - 30 vs 60. For confidential client data, 30 days might be tight but manageable.

I'll trade: accept uni_owns_option_to_licence but push for 45 days review... wait, only 0/30/60/90 are allowed. So I need to choose between 30 and 60. 

Actually, uni_owns_option_to_assign would be stronger for us than option_to_licence while still having the university retain ownership. I'll propose changing IP to that option while restoring review to 60 days - two field changes total, keeping within the limit.
